title: I rebuilt the whole interface of my browser game, here's how it looks now
author: Professional-Emu4891
selftext:
**Arsenal Zero** is a military looter you play in the browser: send your operator on expeditions, come back to open what they found, upgrade your gear.

The old interface looked like a dashboard and new players got lost. So I redid all of it: top menu like a real game, your operator big in the middle, darker military cards, one clear action per screen. I also cut the tutorial down so you launch your first expedition in the first minute. Twice as many new players now reach level 5 on their first day.

The code is assisted by Claude, and so is the soundtrack. Happy to answer questions about the workflow.

[arsenalzero.com](https://arsenalzero.com/en/?src=reddit&utm_campaign=aigamedev_v09)
